Please seek approval for this feature in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before pursuing it here; new features need discussion approval. The [progress documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) explains how to implement a custom `ProgressColumn`, which can format `task.finished_speed or task.speed` with a chosen unit.
